news_items.title: Biigest Asset Managment company of india ICICI Prudential AMC IPO opens for subscription on Dec 12, 2025 and closes on Dec 16, 2025.
The issue is entirely an offer for sale of 4.90 crore shares of Rs.10,602.65 crore.
This IPO price band is set at Rs.2061.00 to Rs.2165.00 per share . The lot size for an application is 6. To be eligible for the Shareholder Quota, you must hold shares in Icici Bank Limited.

This companys revenue increased by 32% and profit after tax (PAT) rose by 29% between the financial year ending with March 31, 2025 and March 31, 2024, its debt free company having surplus of Rs 3,432.85 crore.

market_context: The allotment is expected by December 17
